Question: Using NHANES from 2005 to 2008 we will run weighted logistic regression using exam weights where the predictor is hdl-cholesterol, categorized in  tertiles(%) T1: ≤33, T2: >33 and ≤66, T3: >66. Outcome is diabetic retinopathy based on 4 levels retinopathy severity worse eye. Covariates include age, gender, race, categorized as non-hispanic white, non-hispanic black, mexican american, other race. We will include participants with diabetes defined as one of  self-reported diabetes, “Yes” to take diabetes pills to lower blood sugar or “Yes” to taking_insulin_now, hemoglobin Alc level ≥ 6.5%, oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) ≥ 11.1mmol/L, or serum glucose (Glu) ≥ 7.0mmol/L. We will exclude non-diabetic patients, missing data of hdl-cholesterol or 4 levels retinopathy severity worse eye.

-- STEP 1: Create temp_master_weight

-- TEMP TABLE FOR weight
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp_master_weight;

CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_master_weight AS
SELECT respondent_sequence_number, 
       (full_sample_2_year_mec_exam_weight * 2.0 / 4.0) AS survey_weight
FROM nhanes.demo_d
WHERE full_sample_2_year_mec_exam_weight IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT respondent_sequence_number, 
       (full_sample_2_year_mec_exam_weight * 2.0 / 4.0) AS survey_weight
FROM nhanes.demo_e
WHERE full_sample_2_year_mec_exam_weight IS NOT NULL;


-- STEP 2: Create temp_psu_stratum

-- TEMP TABLE FOR PSU and Stratum
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp_psu_stratum;
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_psu_stratum AS
SELECT respondent_sequence_number, 
       masked_variance_pseudo_psu AS masked_variance_pseudo_psu,
       masked_variance_pseudo_stratum AS masked_variance_pseudo_stratum
FROM nhanes.demo_d
UNION ALL
SELECT respondent_sequence_number, 
       masked_variance_pseudo_psu AS masked_variance_pseudo_psu,
       masked_variance_pseudo_stratum AS masked_variance_pseudo_stratum
FROM nhanes.demo_e;


-- STEP 3: Create final weight+design table
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS weight_design;
CREATE TABLE weight_design AS
SELECT 
    s.respondent_sequence_number,
    s.masked_variance_pseudo_psu,
    s.masked_variance_pseudo_stratum,
    w.survey_weight
FROM temp_psu_stratum s
INNER JOIN temp_master_weight w
  ON s.respondent_sequence_number = w.respondent_sequence_number;

FROM temp_hdl_cholesterol_raw
